item.description: Eating too much salt may do more than raise blood pressure. It could also harm memory and social behavior. item.title: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea
item.description: Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a highly excited yet surprisingly orderly configuration called a "fractional Fermi sea." The discovery challenges established quantum theories and hints at exotic quasiparticles that scientists have dubbed potential "super-Fermions." Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Hace 75.000 años una lanza atravesó el pecho de un neandertal. Sus restos indican que ya entonces cuidaban a sus heridos
item.description: En la famosa cueva de Shanidar , situada en el Kurdistán iraquí, hace unos 75.000 años murió violentamente un neandertal . La víctima (Shanidar A) era un adulto de unos 45 años cuyo omóplato izquierdo presenta una perforación circular compatible con el impacto de una lanza de madera afilada. De esta muerte podemos deducir dos cosas: que en el Paleolítico medio hubo violencia letal y que ya por aquel entonces se cuidaba de sus heridos y de sus muertos. El hallazgo . El equipo de investigación analizó los diminutos fragmentos de hueso desplazados y las fracturas radiales alrededor de un… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Eating blueberries every day may have a surprising effect on your mood
item.description: Eating blueberries every day could have surprising effects on mood, according to a small study that found greater reductions in depressive symptoms among older adults who consumed the fruit for three months. Researchers also detected changes in gut microbial enzymes, suggesting a possible gut-brain connection, although the mood benefits were not statistically significant compared with a placebo. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Florida appeals court overturns $2,675 monthly alimony after a 249-day marriage
item.description: A recent decision by a Florida appeals court reversed an alimony order for a short marriage lasting 249 days. The court found insufficient evidence regarding the former wife's need for financial support. The trial court had awarded nine months of temporary alimony based on prior cases instead of specific proof. The appeals court emphasized the importance of individual cases and relevant evidence in such rulings. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Florida opens $191.8M water plant to protect the Matanzas River and conserve drinking water
item.description: St. Johns County Utilities officials celebrated the completion of the State Road 207 Water Reclamation Facility. This facility, costing $191.8 million, will treat wastewater and provide reclaimed water for irrigation purposes. The project aims to reduce dependence on the Floridan Aquifer, especially during ongoing drought conditions. Capacity of the facility can be expanded to meet future demand while preventing nutrient pollution in local waters. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
